notes: Ludum Dare 46 jam (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/46/wasmball; https://arjunsinh.dev/wasmball/play) by Arjunsinh Shridevsinh Jadeja / itsarjunsinh. Complete Unity 2019.3.10f1 Project Tiny / DOTS game with playable Assets/Scenes/Tiny3D.unity and Assets/Scenes/TIny3D DOTS Subscene.unity, built via Assets/BuildConfigurations (Wasm-Tiny3D and other Tiny configs). EditorBuildSettings.m_Scenes is empty, which is expected for Project Tiny rather than a missing game. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2020 Arjunsinh Shridevsinh Jadeja). Author states the compo was built in 48 hours without any third-party assets; bundled UI is original typography (GameLogo.png / Rules.png). Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json (com.unity.tiny.all 0.24.0-preview.1, TextMesh Pro 2.0.1 as a package not vendored into Assets, Recorder 2.2.0-preview.4, IDE packages, and built-in modules). No bundled fonts, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained.
